title: 光學原子鐘真空與雷射系統~Optical atomic-clock vacuum and laser systems
focus: 鍶光晶格鐘的超高真空、冷卻與鐘雷射、系統位移與 10⁻¹⁸ 級評估~Ultrahigh vacuum, cooling and clock lasers, systematic shifts and 10⁻¹⁸-level evaluation of a strontium lattice clock
summary: 以 ⁸⁷Sr 光晶格鐘為對象，從品質因數與艾倫偏差 σ_y(τ) ∝ 1/(Q·SNR·√τ) 出發，建置原子冷卻與 813 nm 魔術波長晶格、超高真空腔與放氣預算、698 nm 鐘雷射與 ULE 腔，再量化黑體輻射、晶格光位移與密度位移，最後以光纖雜訊消除、鐘比對與系統不確定度表完成可交接的光鐘工程。~Using the ⁸⁷Sr optical lattice clock as the object, this course starts from the quality factor and the Allan deviation σ_y(τ) ∝ 1/(Q·SNR·√τ), builds atom cooling and the 813 nm magic-wavelength lattice, the ultrahigh-vacuum chamber with its outgassing budget, the 698 nm clock laser with its ULE cavity, then quantifies blackbody, lattice light and density shifts, and closes with fibre-noise cancellation, clock comparison and a systematic-uncertainty table for a hand-over-ready optical clock.

units.anchor: 鐘躍遷品質因數與艾倫偏差~Clock-transition quality factor and Allan deviation
units.title: 光鐘的系統邊界與穩定度極限~System boundaries and stability limits of an optical clock
units.mechanism: 光學原子鐘用一束窄線寬雷射去探測原子中一條極窄的躍遷（⁸⁷Sr 的 ¹S₀–³P₀，698 nm，429.228 THz，自然線寬約 1 mHz），把原子的激發機率當作誤差訊號，週期性地修正雷射頻率，再用頻率梳把光頻除頻到可計數的射頻。它比銫鐘好的原因是品質因數 Q = ν/Δν 高了約五個數量級：光頻 4×10¹⁴ Hz 對微波 9×10⁹ Hz。穩定度以艾倫偏差描述，σ_y(τ) ≈ (1/(π·Q·SNR))·√(T_c/τ)，其中 SNR 由原子數的量子投影雜訊限制（SNR = √N），T_c 是包含裝載與探測的鐘週期。系統邊界因此是：真空中一團冷原子、一支鐘雷射、一套冷卻與晶格雷射、以及把光頻帶出去的頻率梳。~An optical atomic clock probes an extremely narrow transition in an atom (for ⁸⁷Sr the ¹S₀–³P₀ line at 698 nm, 429.228 THz, natural linewidth about 1 mHz) with a narrow-linewidth laser, uses the excitation probability as an error signal to correct the laser frequency periodically, and divides the optical frequency down to countable radio frequency with a frequency comb. It beats a caesium clock because the quality factor Q = ν/Δν is about five orders higher: 4×10¹⁴ Hz optical against 9×10⁹ Hz microwave. Stability is described by the Allan deviation σ_y(τ) ≈ (1/(π·Q·SNR))·√(T_c/τ), where SNR is limited by quantum projection noise of the atom number (SNR = √N) and T_c is the clock cycle including loading and probing. The system boundary is therefore a cloud of cold atoms in vacuum, a clock laser, a set of cooling and lattice lasers, and a comb that carries the optical frequency out.
units.model: 取 ν = 429.228 THz、探測線寬 Δν = 1 Hz（約 0.8 s 的 Rabi 脈衝），Q = 4.3×10¹⁴；N = 1000 個原子，SNR = √1000 = 31.6；T_c = 1.5 s。σ_y(1 s) ≈ √1.5/(π×4.3×10¹⁴×31.6) ≈ 2.9×10⁻¹⁷，這是量子投影雜訊極限；要平均到 1×10⁻¹⁸ 需 τ = (2.9×10⁻¹⁷/10⁻¹⁸)² ≈ 830 s。實際上鐘雷射雜訊與迪克效應常把 1 s 穩定度拉到 2×10⁻¹⁶，此時到 1×10⁻¹⁸ 需 4×10⁴ s ≈ 11 小時。~With ν = 429.228 THz and a probe linewidth Δν = 1 Hz (a Rabi pulse of about 0.8 s), Q = 4.3×10¹⁴; with N = 1000 atoms, SNR = √1000 = 31.6; T_c = 1.5 s. Then σ_y(1 s) ≈ √1.5/(π×4.3×10¹⁴×31.6) ≈ 2.9×10⁻¹⁷, the quantum-projection-noise limit; averaging to 1×10⁻¹⁸ takes τ = (2.9×10⁻¹⁷/10⁻¹⁸)² ≈ 830 s. In practice clock-laser noise and the Dick effect often raise the 1 s stability to 2×10⁻¹⁶, and reaching 1×10⁻¹⁸ then takes 4×10⁴ s ≈ 11 hours.
units.verify: 以兩次交錯探測（鐘躍遷線形兩側的半高點）記錄激發機率的逐週期起伏，計算其標準差並與 1/(2√N) 的量子投影雜訊比較；再用頻率梳把鐘雷射與第二台鐘或超穩雷射拍頻計數，畫出艾倫偏差，確認在 1–100 s 區間斜率為 −1/2，且 1 s 的值落在 QPN 與鐘雷射限制之間。~Record the cycle-to-cycle fluctuation of the excitation probability from two interleaved probes at the half-maximum points of the clock line, compute its standard deviation and compare with the 1/(2√N) quantum-projection noise; then count the beat between the clock laser and a second clock or ultrastable laser through the comb, plot the Allan deviation, and confirm a −1/2 slope from 1 to 100 s with the 1 s value lying between the QPN and clock-laser limits.
units.failure: 為了提高 SNR 把原子數增加到 10⁵ 卻沒有擴大晶格體積，密度位移升到 10⁻¹⁶ 等級且隨裝載起伏，穩定度看似變好，準確度卻變差一個數量級。~Raising the atom number to 10⁵ for SNR without enlarging the lattice volume pushes the density shift to the 10⁻¹⁶ level and makes it fluctuate with loading; stability looks better while accuracy worsens by an order of magnitude.
units.misconception: 光鐘比銫鐘準是因為雷射比微波源更穩定。~Optical clocks beat caesium clocks because lasers are more stable than microwave sources.

units.anchor: 461/689 nm 磁光阱與 813 nm 魔術波長晶格~461/689 nm MOTs and the 813 nm magic-wavelength lattice
units.title: 原子冷卻、晶格囚禁與蘭姆—迪克區~Atom cooling, lattice trapping and the Lamb–Dicke regime
units.mechanism: 鍶原子先在 461 nm 的 ¹S₀–¹P₁ 寬線（Γ = 2π×32 MHz）磁光阱中被減速冷卻到毫開爾文，再轉到 689 nm 的 ¹S₀–³P₁ 窄線（Γ = 2π×7.5 kHz）磁光阱冷到微開爾文，然後裝進 813 nm 的一維光晶格。813 nm 是魔術波長：鐘躍遷上下能階的交流極化率相等，晶格光對鐘頻率的一階位移為零。晶格使原子沿探測方向被侷限在遠小於 698 nm 的範圍內（蘭姆—迪克區），都卜勒與反衝位移消失，才能以秒級的探測時間看到 Hz 級的線寬。~Strontium atoms are first slowed and cooled to millikelvin in a magneto-optical trap on the broad 461 nm ¹S₀–¹P₁ line (Γ = 2π×32 MHz), then transferred to a MOT on the narrow 689 nm ¹S₀–³P₁ line (Γ = 2π×7.5 kHz) to reach microkelvin, and finally loaded into a one-dimensional optical lattice at 813 nm. 813 nm is the magic wavelength: the AC polarizabilities of the two clock states are equal, so the first-order lattice light shift of the clock frequency vanishes. The lattice confines the atoms along the probe direction to far less than 698 nm (the Lamb–Dicke regime), eliminating Doppler and recoil shifts so that second-long probes can reveal hertz-level linewidths.
units.model: 都卜勒極限 T_D = ħΓ/(2k_B)：461 nm 藍阱 T_D = 1.055×10⁻³⁴×2π×32×10⁶/(2×1.381×10⁻²³) = 0.77 mK；689 nm 紅阱 T_D = 180 nK，但反衝極限 T_r = ħ²k²/(m·k_B) = 464 nK（m = 86.9 u），所以紅阱實際落在約 1 µK。813 nm 晶格的反衝能 E_r/h = 3.47 kHz（E_r/k_B = 167 nK）；井深 U = 50 E_r = 8.3 µK 時軸向囚禁頻率 ν_z = 2(E_r/h)·√(U/E_r) = 2×3.47×√50 ≈ 49 kHz，遠大於鐘躍遷線寬，滿足蘭姆—迪克條件。~The Doppler limit is T_D = ħΓ/(2k_B): for the 461 nm blue MOT T_D = 1.055×10⁻³⁴×2π×32×10⁶/(2×1.381×10⁻²³) = 0.77 mK; for the 689 nm red MOT T_D = 180 nK, but the recoil limit T_r = ħ²k²/(m·k_B) = 464 nK (m = 86.9 u), so the red MOT actually reaches about 1 µK. The 813 nm lattice recoil energy is E_r/h = 3.47 kHz (E_r/k_B = 167 nK); at a depth U = 50 E_r = 8.3 µK the axial trap frequency is ν_z = 2(E_r/h)·√(U/E_r) = 2×3.47×√50 ≈ 49 kHz, far above the clock linewidth, satisfying the Lamb–Dicke condition.
units.verify: 以飛行時間法量紅阱釋放後原子雲的膨脹速率得到溫度，確認約 1 µK；以鐘雷射掃描晶格中的運動邊帶，量得藍、紅邊帶與載波的頻率間隔即為 ν_z，與 49 kHz 的估計比較，並由邊帶振幅比推算平均振動量子數；調整晶格功率確認 ν_z 隨 √U 變化。~Measure the temperature by time-of-flight expansion of the cloud released from the red MOT, confirming about 1 µK; scan the clock laser across the motional sidebands in the lattice, read the blue- and red-sideband spacing from the carrier as ν_z, compare with the 49 kHz estimate and infer the mean vibrational quantum number from the sideband amplitude ratio; vary the lattice power and confirm that ν_z scales with √U.
units.failure: 晶格光偏離魔術波長 0.1 nm（約 45 GHz）時，上下能階極化率不再相等，鐘頻率隨晶格功率線性漂移，每一次功率起伏都直接變成頻率誤差，準確度卡在 10⁻¹⁵。~With the lattice light 0.1 nm (about 45 GHz) off the magic wavelength the two polarizabilities no longer match, the clock frequency drifts linearly with lattice power, every power fluctuation becomes a frequency error and accuracy stalls at 10⁻¹⁵.
units.misconception: 只要原子夠冷，不用晶格也能用秒級探測得到 Hz 級線寬。~Cold enough atoms give hertz-level linewidths with second-long probes even without a lattice.

units.anchor: 鈦腔體、CF 法蘭與離子／NEG 幫浦~Titanium chamber, CF flanges and ion/NEG pumps
units.title: 超高真空系統：材料、烘烤與放氣預算~The ultrahigh-vacuum system: materials, bake-out and outgassing budget
units.mechanism: 原子必須在超高真空中存活數秒以上：背景氣體碰撞會把原子踢出晶格並造成微小的頻率位移，所以腔體壓力要在 10⁻¹⁰ mbar 以下。腔體用 316L 不銹鋼或鈦（磁性低、放氣少），接口用 CF 法蘭與無氧銅墊圈，視窗為真空側鍍抗反射膜的熔融石英，鍍膜要同時覆蓋 461、689、698 與 813 nm。抽氣以離子幫浦加非蒸發吸氣劑（NEG）為主，無振動；組裝後整體在 150–200 °C 烘烤數天以去除壁面吸附的水，放氣率才能降到設計值。壓力由放氣總量除以有效抽速決定，所以材料面積、烘烤與導管傳導率共同決定最終真空。~Atoms must survive for seconds in ultrahigh vacuum: background-gas collisions knock them out of the lattice and cause small frequency shifts, so chamber pressure must stay below 10⁻¹⁰ mbar. Chambers use 316L stainless steel or titanium (low magnetism, low outgassing), joints use CF flanges with oxygen-free copper gaskets, and viewports are fused silica anti-reflection coated on the vacuum side for 461, 689, 698 and 813 nm simultaneously. Pumping relies on ion pumps plus non-evaporable getters (NEG), both vibration-free; after assembly the whole system is baked at 150–200 °C for days to drive off adsorbed water before the outgassing rate reaches its design value. Pressure equals total outgassing divided by effective pumping speed, so material area, bake-out and conductance together decide the final vacuum.
units.model: 烘烤後的不銹鋼放氣率約 1×10⁻¹² mbar·L/(s·cm²)；內表面 3000 cm² 的腔體放氣 Q = 3×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s，有效抽速 50 L/s 時 p = Q/S = 6×10⁻¹¹ mbar。未烘烤（1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/(s·cm²)）則 p = 6×10⁻⁹ mbar，差 100 倍。在 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar（室溫數密度 n = p/(k_B T) = 2.4×10¹² m⁻³）、碰撞損失係數 5×10⁻¹⁵ m³/s 時晶格壽命 τ = 1/(k·n) ≈ 80 s，對 1 s 的探測足夠。~Baked stainless steel outgasses at about 1×10⁻¹² mbar·L/(s·cm²); a chamber with 3000 cm² of inner surface emits Q = 3×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s, and with 50 L/s effective pumping speed p = Q/S = 6×10⁻¹¹ mbar. Unbaked (1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/(s·cm²)) it would be p = 6×10⁻⁹ mbar, 100 times worse. At 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar (room-temperature number density n = p/(k_B T) = 2.4×10¹² m⁻³) and a collisional loss coefficient of 5×10⁻¹⁵ m³/s, the lattice lifetime is τ = 1/(k·n) ≈ 80 s, ample for 1 s probes.
units.verify: 以殘氣分析儀在烘烤前後記錄 H₂O（18）、H₂（2）與碳氫峰，確認烘烤後水峰下降兩個數量級；用離子幫浦電流與冷陰極規交叉核對壓力；最後量晶格中原子數隨保持時間的指數衰減，壽命應與 1/(k·n) 的估計同量級，若明顯偏短則表示有洩漏或虛漏。~Record H₂O (mass 18), H₂ (mass 2) and hydrocarbon peaks with a residual-gas analyser before and after bake-out, confirming a two-order drop of the water peak; cross-check pressure from ion-pump current and a cold-cathode gauge; finally measure the exponential decay of atom number in the lattice versus hold time, whose lifetime should match the 1/(k·n) estimate, a clearly shorter value pointing to a leak or virtual leak.
units.failure: 視窗鍍膜只為 698 nm 最佳化，461 nm 的反射率達 8%，散射的藍光打在腔壁與原子上造成光位移與載入效率下降；更換視窗意味著破真空、重新烘烤並損失數週。~Viewport coatings optimised only for 698 nm reflect 8% at 461 nm, and the scattered blue light hitting walls and atoms causes light shifts and poor loading; replacing the windows means breaking vacuum, rebaking and losing weeks.
units.misconception: 真空只要「夠低」讓原子不被碰掉就好，對鐘的準確度沒有直接影響。~Vacuum only needs to be low enough to keep atoms from being knocked out and has no direct effect on clock accuracy.

units.anchor: 698 nm 鐘雷射與 ULE 參考腔~698 nm clock laser and the ULE reference cavity
units.title: 雷射系統：冷卻雷射、晶格雷射與鐘雷射~Laser systems: cooling, lattice and clock lasers
units.mechanism: 鍶鐘需要四種波長：461 nm（由 922 nm 二極體雷射倍頻或直接藍光二極體）、689 nm 窄線寬冷卻光、813 nm 晶格光（鈦藍寶石或錐形放大器，需數百 mW 到 W 級且頻率鎖定）、698 nm 鐘雷射，另加 679 與 707 nm 回泵光。鐘雷射是整個系統的心臟：外腔二極體雷射以龐德—德瑞弗—霍爾（PDH）法鎖到真空中、溫控在零膨脹點的 ULE 玻璃法布里—珀羅腔，腔的高精細度把雷射線寬壓到 Hz 以下，殘餘不穩定度由腔鏡與間隔器的布朗熱雜訊決定。~A strontium clock needs four wavelengths: 461 nm (frequency-doubled 922 nm diode laser or direct blue diode), 689 nm narrow-linewidth cooling light, 813 nm lattice light (titanium-sapphire or tapered amplifier, hundreds of milliwatts to watts and frequency-locked), and the 698 nm clock laser, plus 679 and 707 nm repumpers. The clock laser is the heart of the system: an external-cavity diode laser locked by the Pound–Drever–Hall (PDH) method to a ULE-glass Fabry–Pérot cavity held in vacuum at its zero-expansion temperature; the cavity's high finesse narrows the laser below 1 Hz, and the residual instability is set by Brownian thermal noise of the mirrors and spacer.
units.model: 腔長 L = 100 mm、精細度 F = 3×10⁵：自由光譜範圍 c/(2L) = 1.50 GHz，腔線寬 1.50 GHz/3×10⁵ = 5.0 kHz。雷射頻率追隨腔長 Δν/ν = −ΔL/L：腔長變化 1 pm 就使 429 THz 的雷射移動 4.3 kHz；要達到 1×10⁻¹⁶ 的穩定度，腔長必須穩定在 10⁻¹⁶×0.1 m = 10 am（10⁻¹⁷ m），這就是為何腔要放在真空、多層熱屏蔽與主動溫控中，並以熔融石英鏡基板降低熱雜訊。~For a cavity of length L = 100 mm and finesse F = 3×10⁵, the free spectral range is c/(2L) = 1.50 GHz and the cavity linewidth 1.50 GHz/3×10⁵ = 5.0 kHz. The laser follows the cavity length through Δν/ν = −ΔL/L: a 1 pm length change moves the 429 THz laser by 4.3 kHz, and a stability of 1×10⁻¹⁶ demands the length be held to 10⁻¹⁶×0.1 m = 10 am (10⁻¹⁷ m), which is why the cavity sits in vacuum behind multiple thermal shields with active temperature control and uses fused-silica mirror substrates to lower thermal noise.
units.verify: 以腔的衰盪（ring-down）時間量精細度：τ_rd = F·L/(πc)，F = 3×10⁵ 時約 32 µs，與 5 kHz 線寬一致；以兩套獨立腔穩頻雷射拍頻，計算艾倫偏差並確認 1–10 s 的平台接近熱雜訊預測；掃描腔溫找出零膨脹點（拍頻對溫度的拋物線頂點），把溫控設定在該點 ±10 mK 內。~Measure finesse by cavity ring-down: τ_rd = F·L/(πc), about 32 µs for F = 3×10⁵, consistent with the 5 kHz linewidth; beat two independently cavity-stabilised lasers, compute the Allan deviation and confirm that the 1–10 s floor approaches the thermal-noise prediction; scan the cavity temperature to find the zero-expansion point (the vertex of the beat-versus-temperature parabola) and set the control within ±10 mK of it.
units.failure: ULE 腔的溫度設在零膨脹點以外 1 K，二次膨脹係數使腔長對溫度的斜率約 2×10⁻⁹/K，溫控的 1 mK 起伏就造成 2×10⁻¹² 的頻率漂移——比鐘的目標差六個數量級，鐘伺服永遠在追雷射。~Operating the ULE cavity 1 K away from its zero-expansion point gives a length slope of about 2×10⁻⁹/K from the quadratic expansion coefficient, so 1 mK of temperature ripple produces 2×10⁻¹² frequency drift, six orders worse than the clock's goal, and the clock servo is forever chasing the laser.
units.misconception: 鐘雷射的線寬只取決於二極體雷射本身的品質。~The clock laser's linewidth depends only on the quality of the diode laser itself.

units.anchor: 黑體輻射位移與腔體溫度~Blackbody-radiation shift and chamber temperature
units.title: 系統頻率位移的量測與修正~Measuring and correcting systematic frequency shifts
units.mechanism: 光鐘的準確度由一張系統位移表決定，每一項都要被量測、修正並給出不確定度。黑體輻射位移來自室溫環境輻射對鐘能階的交流史塔克位移，與溫度的四次方成正比，是鍶鐘最大的一項；晶格光位移以在不同晶格深度下量鐘頻率外推到零深度來評估；密度位移以改變原子數外推；二階季曼位移以量兩個對稱的塞曼分量間距得到磁場並計算；背景氣體碰撞位移與探測光位移則分別由壓力與探測功率的相依性評估。這些量測都用「交錯」方式進行：兩組條件逐週期交替，以消除雷射漂移。~An optical clock's accuracy is set by a table of systematic shifts, each measured, corrected and assigned an uncertainty. The blackbody-radiation shift is the AC Stark shift of the clock levels by room-temperature thermal radiation, scales with the fourth power of temperature and is the largest item for strontium; the lattice light shift is evaluated by measuring the clock frequency at several lattice depths and extrapolating to zero; the density shift by varying atom number; the second-order Zeeman shift by measuring the splitting of two symmetric Zeeman components to obtain the field and computing the shift; background-gas and probe-light shifts from their dependence on pressure and probe power. All are measured in interleaved fashion, alternating two conditions cycle by cycle to cancel laser drift.
units.model: ⁸⁷Sr 在 300 K 的黑體輻射位移約 −5×10⁻¹⁵（相對值），按 T⁴ 變化，故 δ(Δν)/Δν = 4·δT/T。若要把此項不確定度壓到 5×10⁻¹⁹，需 δT/T = (5×10⁻¹⁹/5×10⁻¹⁵)/4 = 2.5×10⁻⁵，即 δT = 300 K×2.5×10⁻⁵ = 7.5 mK：腔體溫度必須以校正過的鉑電阻溫度計在多點量到 10 mK 以內，且原子看到的有效溫度要考慮視窗與加熱元件的輻射。~The ⁸⁷Sr blackbody shift at 300 K is about −5×10⁻¹⁵ fractionally and scales as T⁴, so δ(Δν)/Δν = 4·δT/T. To hold this item's uncertainty to 5×10⁻¹⁹ requires δT/T = (5×10⁻¹⁹/5×10⁻¹⁵)/4 = 2.5×10⁻⁵, i.e. δT = 300 K×2.5×10⁻⁵ = 7.5 mK: the chamber temperature must be measured at several points with calibrated platinum thermometers to within 10 mK, and the effective temperature seen by the atoms must account for radiation from windows and heated elements.
units.verify: 在腔體外壁與視窗座安裝至少 6 支校正鉑電阻，記錄 24 小時溫度分佈並以有限元素模型推算原子位置的有效輻射溫度；以交錯量測在晶格深度 50、100、200 E_r 下取鐘頻率，線性外推到零深度得到晶格光位移與其斜率；原子數減半重做，得到密度位移係數。~Mount at least six calibrated platinum thermometers on the chamber walls and viewport mounts, log the 24 hour temperature distribution and compute the effective radiation temperature at the atoms with a finite-element model; take interleaved clock frequencies at lattice depths of 50, 100 and 200 E_r and extrapolate linearly to zero to obtain the lattice light shift and its slope; repeat with half the atom number to obtain the density-shift coefficient.
units.failure: 鐘雷射的回泵或冷卻光的雜散光經由視窗進入晶格區，造成未被列入位移表的額外光位移，鐘與另一台鐘比對時出現 3×10⁻¹⁷ 的無法解釋偏差，追查數月才發現是一片未關閉的機械快門。~Stray repumper or cooling light leaking through a viewport into the lattice region causes an extra light shift absent from the table, the clock shows an unexplained 3×10⁻¹⁷ offset against another clock, and months of searching end at a mechanical shutter that never fully closed.
units.misconception: 只要實驗室溫度控制在 ±0.5 °C，黑體輻射位移就可以忽略。~With the laboratory held to ±0.5 °C, the blackbody-radiation shift can be ignored.

units.anchor: 系統不確定度表與迪克效應~Systematic-uncertainty table and the Dick effect
units.title: 不確定度預算與穩定度瓶頸~Uncertainty budget and stability bottlenecks
units.mechanism: 準確度預算把各項位移的不確定度以均方根合成，目標是 10⁻¹⁸ 等級；穩定度預算則找出到達該準確度所需的平均時間。迪克效應是穩定度的主要瓶頸：鐘週期中只有探測時段對雷射頻率取樣，裝載與冷卻的死時間讓雷射在探測頻率諧波處的雜訊被降頻混疊進誤差訊號，使穩定度比量子投影雜訊極限差一個數量級；對策是縮短死時間、改善鐘雷射，或以兩套原子系統交錯探測（零死時間）。預算表的另一個用途是指出哪一項值得投入：黑體輻射與晶格位移通常並列最大。~The accuracy budget combines the uncertainties of all shifts root-sum-square with a target at the 10⁻¹⁸ level; the stability budget finds the averaging time needed to reach that accuracy. The Dick effect is the main stability bottleneck: only the probe interval of each cycle samples the laser frequency, and the dead time for loading and cooling aliases laser noise at harmonics of the cycle frequency into the error signal, making stability an order worse than the quantum-projection limit; remedies are shorter dead time, a better clock laser, or two atomic systems probed in interleaved fashion (zero dead time). The table also shows where effort pays off: blackbody and lattice shifts are usually tied for largest.
units.model: 預算（相對值，k = 1，教學假設）：黑體輻射 5×10⁻¹⁹、晶格光位移 6×10⁻¹⁹、密度位移 3×10⁻¹⁹、二階季曼 2×10⁻¹⁹、背景氣體 3×10⁻¹⁹、伺服誤差 2×10⁻¹⁹。合成 = √(25 + 36 + 9 + 4 + 9 + 4)×10⁻¹⁹ = √87×10⁻¹⁹ = 9.3×10⁻¹⁹。若晶格光位移改善到 3×10⁻¹⁹，總值降到 7.5×10⁻¹⁹；但若黑體項惡化到 2×10⁻¹⁸（溫度只量到 30 mK），總值跳到 2.2×10⁻¹⁸，其他項的努力全被淹沒。~Budget (fractional, k = 1, teaching assumptions): blackbody 5×10⁻¹⁹, lattice light shift 6×10⁻¹⁹, density 3×10⁻¹⁹, second-order Zeeman 2×10⁻¹⁹, background gas 3×10⁻¹⁹, servo error 2×10⁻¹⁹. Combined = √(25 + 36 + 9 + 4 + 9 + 4)×10⁻¹⁹ = √87×10⁻¹⁹ = 9.3×10⁻¹⁹. Improving the lattice shift to 3×10⁻¹⁹ lowers the total to 7.5×10⁻¹⁹; but letting the blackbody term degrade to 2×10⁻¹⁸ (temperature known only to 30 mK) jumps the total to 2.2×10⁻¹⁸ and drowns every other effort.
units.verify: 把鐘週期的死時間從 0.7 s 縮到 0.3 s 並量艾倫偏差，確認 1 s 穩定度依迪克效應模型改善；以鐘雷射的量測相位雜訊譜代入迪克公式計算預期的穩定度，與量測值比較在 30% 內；每季重新評估預算表中最大的兩項並記錄變化。~Shorten the dead time from 0.7 s to 0.3 s and remeasure the Allan deviation, confirming that the 1 s stability improves as the Dick-effect model predicts; feed the measured clock-laser phase-noise spectrum into the Dick formula and compare the predicted stability with measurement within 30%; re-evaluate the two largest table items every quarter and log the changes.
units.failure: 穩定度長期停在 5×10⁻¹⁶/√τ，團隊花一年改善原子數與晶格，卻沒有量鐘雷射的相位雜訊譜；最後發現腔的隔振平台失效，迪克效應放大了 1–10 Hz 的地面振動。~Stability sits at 5×10⁻¹⁶/√τ for a year while the team improves atom number and lattice without measuring the clock laser's phase-noise spectrum; the cause turns out to be a failed vibration-isolation platform under the cavity, whose 1–10 Hz ground motion the Dick effect amplifies.
units.misconception: 準確度與穩定度是同一件事，艾倫偏差小就代表鐘準。~Accuracy and stability are the same thing, so a small Allan deviation means the clock is accurate.

units.anchor: 光纖雜訊消除與磁屏蔽~Fibre-noise cancellation and magnetic shielding
units.title: 系統整合：光路、磁場、時序與環境~System integration: optical paths, magnetic field, timing and environment
units.mechanism: 鐘雷射從腔到原子要走數公尺到數十公尺的光纖，光纖的熱與聲學相位雜訊會直接加到鐘頻率上，必須用往返干涉的主動光纖雜訊消除把參考面延伸到原子附近。磁場由三軸線圈與 µ 金屬屏蔽控制，偏置場要穩定到 µT 以下以壓低一階與二階季曼效應；時序由 FPGA 或實時控制器以 µs 精度排程冷卻、裝載、探測與偵測。冷卻光與晶格光的功率、頻率與偏振各自需要伺服，整個系統有數十個鎖迴路同時運作，任何一個失鎖都必須被自動偵測並觸發重鎖。~The clock laser travels metres to tens of metres of fibre from cavity to atoms, and the fibre's thermal and acoustic phase noise adds directly to the clock frequency, so active fibre-noise cancellation with a round-trip interferometer extends the reference plane to the atoms. The magnetic field is controlled by three-axis coils and mu-metal shielding, with the bias field stable below the microtesla level to suppress first- and second-order Zeeman effects; timing is scheduled by an FPGA or real-time controller with microsecond precision for cooling, loading, probing and detection. Power, frequency and polarization of cooling and lattice light each need their own servo, so dozens of lock loops run simultaneously and any loss of lock must be detected automatically and trigger a relock.
units.model: 10 m 光纖、熱光係數 1×10⁻⁵/K：溫度變化 1 K 使光程變化 10 m×10⁻⁵ = 1×10⁻⁴ m，相位變化 2π×10⁻⁴/698×10⁻⁹ = 900 rad；若在 100 s 內發生，等效頻率偏移 900/(2π×100) = 1.43 Hz，相對值 1.43/429.228×10¹² = 3.3×10⁻¹⁵，比鐘的目標差三個數量級。開啟光纖雜訊消除後殘餘通常低於 10⁻¹⁸，但往返路徑外的最後一段自由空間光路（約 0.3 m）仍須機械穩固。~For 10 m of fibre with a thermo-optic coefficient of 1×10⁻⁵/K, a 1 K change alters the optical path by 10 m×10⁻⁵ = 1×10⁻⁴ m, a phase change of 2π×10⁻⁴/698×10⁻⁹ = 900 rad; occurring over 100 s this is an equivalent frequency offset of 900/(2π×100) = 1.43 Hz, fractionally 1.43/429.228×10¹² = 3.3×10⁻¹⁵, three orders beyond the clock's goal. With fibre-noise cancellation on, the residual is usually below 10⁻¹⁸, but the last free-space stretch outside the round-trip path (about 0.3 m) still needs mechanical rigidity.
units.verify: 用往返拍頻在消除開啟與關閉時各計數 1000 s，確認關閉時的 10⁻¹⁵ 級漂移在開啟後低於 10⁻¹⁸；以磁通計在原子位置量三軸場並掃描屏蔽開口方向，確認殘餘場穩定度優於 0.1 µT；最後做一次「全系統拔插」測試：關閉再開啟實驗室照明與空調，確認所有迴路在 60 s 內自動恢復。~Count the round-trip beat for 1000 s with cancellation on and off, confirming that the 10⁻¹⁵-level drift when off falls below 10⁻¹⁸ when on; measure the three-axis field at the atom position with a fluxgate magnetometer, scanning the orientation of the shield openings, and confirm residual-field stability better than 0.1 µT; finally run a whole-system disturbance test by switching the laboratory lighting and air-conditioning off and on and confirming that every loop recovers automatically within 60 s.
units.failure: 光纖雜訊消除的參考反射面放在光纖末端而非原子附近的自由空間鏡，最後一段 1 m 的光路經過一台風扇冷卻的放大器，2 Hz 的氣流相位調制讓鐘的 1 s 穩定度惡化三倍且出現週期性結構。~Placing the fibre-noise-cancellation reference reflector at the fibre end rather than on a free-space mirror near the atoms leaves the last metre of path passing a fan-cooled amplifier, whose 2 Hz airflow phase modulation triples the clock's 1 s instability and adds periodic structure.
units.misconception: 單模光纖只是把光從 A 點送到 B 點，不會改變光的頻率。~A single-mode fibre merely moves light from A to B and cannot change its frequency.

units.anchor: 鐘比對、頻率比值與交接文件~Clock comparison, frequency ratios and handoff file
units.title: 驗證、國際比對與工程交接~Validation, international comparison and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 一台光鐘的準確度宣稱只有透過與其他鐘比對才算被驗證：同一實驗室的第二台鐘（同種或異種原子，透過頻率梳量頻率比值）、藉由光纖鏈路或衛星連接的其他國家實驗室的鐘、以及與銫噴泉鐘比對以得到對 SI 秒的絕對頻率。比對結果以頻率比值與其不確定度呈現，並與各鐘的系統不確定度表核對一致性。交接文件應包含：真空系統的放氣與壓力紀錄、所有雷射的鎖定參數與功率、位移表與其量測日期、溫度計校正證書、光纖雜訊消除的驗證資料，以及連續運轉時數與失鎖事件紀錄。~A clock's accuracy claim counts as validated only through comparison with other clocks: a second clock in the same laboratory (same or different species, with the frequency ratio measured through a comb), clocks at other national laboratories linked by fibre or satellite, and a caesium fountain to obtain the absolute frequency against the SI second. Results are reported as frequency ratios with uncertainties and checked for consistency with each clock's systematic table. The handoff file should contain the vacuum system's outgassing and pressure logs, every laser's lock parameters and powers, the shift table with measurement dates, thermometer calibration certificates, the fibre-noise-cancellation validation data, and the record of continuous operating hours and loss-of-lock events.
units.model: 兩台鐘比對的合成穩定度 σ_y(τ) = 3×10⁻¹⁶/√τ（教學假設）：要把統計不確定度平均到 1×10⁻¹⁸，需 τ = (3×10⁻¹⁶/10⁻¹⁸)² = 9×10⁴ s = 25 小時的有效資料；若鐘的運轉率只有 50%，就需要兩天以上。比對結果若差 2×10⁻¹⁸，而兩鐘系統不確定度各為 1×10⁻¹⁸，合成 1.4×10⁻¹⁸，差異為 1.4σ，尚可接受；差 5×10⁻¹⁸ 則表示某張位移表有遺漏。~Two clocks compared with a combined stability σ_y(τ) = 3×10⁻¹⁶/√τ (teaching assumption) need τ = (3×10⁻¹⁶/10⁻¹⁸)² = 9×10⁴ s = 25 hours of valid data to average the statistical uncertainty to 1×10⁻¹⁸; at 50% uptime that is more than two days. A 2×10⁻¹⁸ difference against systematic uncertainties of 1×10⁻¹⁸ each (combined 1.4×10⁻¹⁸) is 1.4σ and acceptable; a 5×10⁻¹⁸ difference means some shift table is missing an item.
units.verify: 安排一次至少 48 小時的連續比對：記錄每秒的頻率比值、兩鐘的所有伺服與環境監測值；剔除失鎖段後計算艾倫偏差與平均值，確認統計不確定度到達 10⁻¹⁸ 且差異在合成系統不確定度的 2 倍內；把比對報告、位移表與運轉紀錄一併歸檔作為交接基準。~Schedule a continuous comparison of at least 48 hours, logging the frequency ratio every second together with all servo and environmental monitors of both clocks; after removing loss-of-lock segments compute the Allan deviation and mean, confirm that the statistical uncertainty reaches 10⁻¹⁸ and that the difference lies within twice the combined systematic uncertainty; archive the comparison report, shift tables and operating log as the handoff baseline.
units.failure: 位移表沿用兩年前的黑體輻射評估，期間腔體加裝了一支 30 °C 的加熱視窗卻沒有重新評估有效溫度；比對時出現 8×10⁻¹⁸ 的偏差，整份準確度宣稱必須撤回重做。~The shift table reuses a two-year-old blackbody evaluation although a 30 °C heated viewport was added to the chamber without re-evaluating the effective temperature; the comparison reveals an 8×10⁻¹⁸ offset and the entire accuracy claim has to be withdrawn and redone.
units.misconception: 一台鐘的系統不確定度表做完一次，就能永久代表它的準確度。~Once a clock's systematic table is completed, it represents the clock's accuracy permanently.

example: 鍶晶格鐘設計核對：鐘躍遷 ν = 429.228 THz，探測線寬 1 Hz（Q = 4.3×10¹⁴），N = 1000 個原子（SNR = 31.6），週期 T_c = 1.5 s：量子投影雜訊極限 σ_y(1 s) ≈ √1.5/(π×4.3×10¹⁴×31.6) ≈ 2.9×10⁻¹⁷；若鐘雷射與迪克效應把 1 s 穩定度限制在 2×10⁻¹⁶，平均到 1×10⁻¹⁸ 需 (2×10⁻¹⁶/10⁻¹⁸)² = 4×10⁴ s ≈ 11 小時。真空：烘烤後放氣 1×10⁻¹² mbar·L/(s·cm²)×3000 cm² = 3×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s，抽速 50 L/s 給 6×10⁻¹¹ mbar，晶格壽命約 80 s。鐘雷射腔：L = 100 mm、F = 3×10⁵，FSR 1.50 GHz、線寬 5.0 kHz，1×10⁻¹⁶ 的穩定度對應腔長 10 am。黑體輻射：300 K 位移 −5×10⁻¹⁵，要把不確定度壓到 5×10⁻¹⁹ 需腔溫知道到 7.5 mK。系統預算合成 9.3×10⁻¹⁹。光纖：10 m、1 K 的漂移在 100 s 內給 3.3×10⁻¹⁵，光纖雜訊消除為必要。所有數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何實驗室的實際評估。~Strontium lattice-clock design check: clock transition ν = 429.228 THz, probe linewidth 1 Hz (Q = 4.3×10¹⁴), N = 1000 atoms (SNR = 31.6), cycle T_c = 1.5 s: the quantum-projection limit is σ_y(1 s) ≈ √1.5/(π×4.3×10¹⁴×31.6) ≈ 2.9×10⁻¹⁷; if clock-laser noise and the Dick effect limit the 1 s stability to 2×10⁻¹⁶, averaging to 1×10⁻¹⁸ takes (2×10⁻¹⁶/10⁻¹⁸)² = 4×10⁴ s ≈ 11 hours. Vacuum: baked outgassing 1×10⁻¹² mbar·L/(s·cm²)×3000 cm² = 3×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s with 50 L/s pumping gives 6×10⁻¹¹ mbar and a lattice lifetime near 80 s. Clock-laser cavity: L = 100 mm, F = 3×10⁵, FSR 1.50 GHz, linewidth 5.0 kHz, and 1×10⁻¹⁶ stability corresponds to 10 am of cavity length. Blackbody: the 300 K shift is −5×10⁻¹⁵, and holding its uncertainty to 5×10⁻¹⁹ requires the chamber temperature to be known to 7.5 mK. The systematic budget combines to 9.3×10⁻¹⁹. Fibre: 10 m with a 1 K drift over 100 s gives 3.3×10⁻¹⁵, so fibre-noise cancellation is mandatory. All values are teaching assumptions, not any laboratory's actual evaluation.
history: 2000 年前後自參考頻率梳的出現使光頻可以被直接計數，光鐘才從構想變成可行；2001–2003 年香取秀俊提出以魔術波長光晶格囚禁中性原子的構想，2005–2006 年東京大學、JILA 與 LNE-SYRTE 相繼實現鍶晶格鐘。2010 年代 JILA 的鍶鐘與 NIST 的鐿鐘把系統不確定度推進到 10⁻¹⁸ 等級，PTB 在 2017 年展示可運輸的鍶鐘；國際計量界已將光鐘的頻率比值納入 SI 秒重新定義的路線圖，目標在 2030 年前後。本課重建的是公開文獻中的真空、雷射與評估方法，不涉及任何實驗室的專有設計。~The arrival of self-referenced frequency combs around 2000 made optical frequencies directly countable and turned optical clocks from a concept into a feasible instrument; between 2001 and 2003 Hidetoshi Katori proposed trapping neutral atoms in a magic-wavelength lattice, and strontium lattice clocks were realised at the University of Tokyo, JILA and LNE-SYRTE in 2005 and 2006. During the 2010s JILA's strontium and NIST's ytterbium clocks pushed systematic uncertainty to the 10⁻¹⁸ level, and PTB demonstrated a transportable strontium clock in 2017; the international metrology community has placed optical-clock frequency ratios on the roadmap toward a redefinition of the SI second targeted around 2030. This course reconstructs vacuum, laser and evaluation methods from public literature, not any laboratory's proprietary design.
